title.narrative: Promotion of Youth Employment in Mozambique

description.narrative: The UN family has been implementing a Youth Employment Promotion Programme through the #Deliver as One Approach# in Mozambique aimed to engage youth in the national efforts to reduce poverty.UNIDO has implemented a capacity building project that resulted in creating the Advisory Centre for Industrial Development (CADI), an important tool to promote entrepreneurship development initiatives and assist the emerging and existing businesses by providing business counseling on a continuous and sustainable base. The aim of the project in Mozambique was to hasten the pace of economic growth and poverty alleviation through promotion of youth employment and income generating activities by implementing the Enterprise Development Programme for new enterprise creation and enterprise upgrading.
